claims.statement: e2b-client is a publishable async Rust client for the standard E2B API, usable against hosted E2B and E2B-compatible servers.

verdicts.rationale: v0.1 is verified (wire claims all supported, every v0.1 behaviour supported live on hosted E2B), but parity (M2, M3) and publishability (M4, M5) are not yet met.

claims.statement: The client covers the official SDK's Sandbox/SandboxApi lifecycle surface against hosted E2B.

verdicts.rationale: All 21 v0.1 lifecycle claims are supported live on hosted E2B, but parity needs the gap claims CLM-0028..0032 (M3).

claims.statement: The client covers the official SDK's Commands (process) surface against hosted E2B.

verdicts.rationale: All 13 v0.1 command claims are supported live on hosted E2B, but parity needs StreamInput and PTY (CLM-0046..0049, M2).

claims.statement: The client covers the official SDK's Filesystem surface against hosted E2B.

verdicts.rationale: All 12 v0.1 filesystem claims are supported live on hosted E2B, but parity needs CLM-0062..0066 (M2).

claims.statement: Every wire fact in docs/protocol-notes.md is implemented as documented.

evidence.locator: claims ledger: children of CLM-0005 (CLM-0067..0116 minus retired 0085, plus 0127); docs/verification/s4-evidence-map.md @ 8cd5040
evidence.summary: All 51 active S4 child claims have supported verdicts from tests passing at 8cd5040 (CLM-0071 and CLM-0109 after fixes #18/#19; CLM-0085 retired and replaced by CLM-0127).

verdicts.rationale: Every child wire claim is supported by passing tests at 8cd5040.

claims.statement: The crate meets the bar for publishing on crates.io: live-verified, stable reviewed API, documented, released.

verdicts.rationale: Live verification on hosted E2B done (CLM-0117), but API review, docs enforcement, MSRV, live CI and publishing remain (M4, M5).
